purpose: B07.02 exact-run CI evidence artifact persistence and verification. The artifact is CI evidence only and is not deployable.
notes: The same workflow job uploaded and downloaded the artifact, verified the SHA-256 digest, and the checker accepted the exact commit/run metadata, bundle manifest, coverage and Playwright report while rejecting dist/.

This successful Playwright run produced no retry/failure traces. The workflow uploads test-results when Playwright creates it; the verifier reports the observed trace count and permits zero for a clean run.

Earlier runs #26 and #27 on commit 933b55e failed only because the first verifier version incorrectly required test-results to exist on a fully passing Playwright run. Commit 104896e corrected that condition, added the clean-run case, and run #28 passed.
The artifact validates this exact CI run and commit. It does not prove backend/staging behavior, user acceptance or remote required-status enforcement.
